Indian Stock Markets Surge to Eight-Month Highs on Foreign Inflows

Indian stock markets experienced a significant rally on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, with the Sensex surging over 1,350 points and the Nifty crossing the 25,400 mark to reach eight-month highs. The rally was driven by strong foreign portfolio inflows, softer crude oil prices, positive global market cues, and rupee appreciation. Several companies, including IndiGo and Mahindra & Mahindra (M&M), were among the leading gainers, while the PSU Bank Index hit a record high. The total market capitalization saw an increase of approximately Rs 6 lakh crore.
